EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows aliphatic C–H stretches at 2964/2946/2887 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), no aromatic ~1600 cm⁻¹ and no carbonyl 1650–1750 cm⁻¹ band, but multiple strong features diagnostic of a sulfonamide/sulfamate: νas(SO2) near 1357 cm⁻¹ and νs(SO2) in the 1130–1180 cm⁻¹ cluster (1134/1171/1183), strong bands near 994/1023 cm⁻¹ consistent with N–O/S–N stretching, a prominent S–O deformation around 539 cm⁻¹, and several S–O–C-related modes in the 770–900 cm⁻¹ region (801/826/872). These collectively fit CC(C)COS(=O)(=O)NO (sulfamate ester) best among the candidates.
